learning_objective: 🎯 Discover how music acts as a magical glue that brings communities together during festivals, celebrations, and everyday life!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Music has a special power to bring people together. Whether it is a stadium full of fans singing a sports chant or families singing at a wedding, music makes us feel like we are part of one big team.
Imagine Diwali, Holi, or Eid without music! Every festival in our society has its own special songs and drum beats that tell the story of the celebration and spread joy.
Sometimes, musicians write songs to spread good messages, like protecting the environment, showing kindness, or standing up for what is right. Music can actually help change the world!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Interview Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Ask your parents or grandparents about a song that was very popular in their community when they were young. Listen to the song together and talk about the positive message it shares!

quick_recap: ⭐ Music connects people from different backgrounds and creates a strong sense of community.
⭐ Festivals and celebrations are incomplete without their special traditional music.
⭐ National anthems unite the entire country with a feeling of pride.
⭐ Songs can spread powerful social messages and encourage positive change in society.
